title: confiture migrate squash-ledger --format json
description: The pending squashed baselines `migrate squash-ledger` recorded without running them, on a database that applied every migration each one squashed. A database whose ledger holds part of that history is refused (VALID_008) with the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json).

recorded.description: The baselines' versions, in order; with --dry-run, those that would be recorded. Empty when there is none to record.

dry_run.description: True with --dry-run: the ledger was not changed.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
